items.summary: Risk disposition: counsel_required; public launch is blocked. Keep searchwoot.com private and do not send rights outreach or change the gate. Human counsel must review source rights, privacy/jurisdiction treatment, vendor terms, and any affiliate or advertising use. Ordinary reversible growth elsewhere may continue within existing consent, disclosure, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed. Public source documentation and partial repository evidence are attached, but none satisfies its full deliverable. Next evidence action: attach one dated read-only bundle covering the four task gaps, without production changes, new tracking, outreach, or duplicate telemetry requests.

Keep searchwoot.com private. Produce the smallest read-only evidence artifacts for data flow, retention, deletion/correction/access, consent behavior, GA4 configuration, log fields, vendor coverage, and incident handling. Do not enable tracking, change configuration, deploy, or send external requests.

Confirm the exact decision: keep searchwoot.com private, leave Woot rights outreach unsent, and require human counsel review before any bounded beta, affiliate use, advertising, public display, alerts, or expanded data processing.
